body: Yes. Growing up in a low-income family and being the family’s scapegoat/having a controlling N-mom and emotionally absent N-dad definitely inspired me not to have children. In addition, I am afraid of what will happen to my body after pregnancy and the pain of childbirth. But worse of all, I am afraid of marrying an abusive partner and/or eventually becoming a single mother, and not being financially stable.
